rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a physical fence around land or a property.

example.english: We need to put up a fence here so the dogs don't run out.
example.traditional: 呢度要加道圍欄，等啲狗唔好走出去。
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jiu3 gaa1 dou6 wai4 laan4 dang2 di1 gau2 m4 hou2 zau2 ceot1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when “fence” means an abstract or actual boundary rather than the physical structure itself.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gaai3 sin3 m4 ho2 ji5 jyut6 gwo3

rows.note: Use this for a figurative barrier or obstacle, including a psychological or emotional one.

example.english: They have an emotional fence around them, so it's hard for them to trust people.
example.traditional: 佢心入面有道障礙，好難再相信人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sam1 jap6 min6 jau5 dou6 zoeng3 ngoi6 hou2 naan4 zoi3 soeng1 seon3 jan4
